scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../things-link-client-contracts contract:check && pnpm --dir ../things-link-client-contracts build && pnpm run python scripts/host-candidate.py prepare && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && pnpm run python scripts/host-candidate.py build
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm api:check && pnpm test && pnpm run python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests
scripts.python: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const r = spawnSync(process.env.PYTHON || (process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python' : 'python3'), process.argv.slice(1), { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, PYTHONUTF8: '1' } }); if (r.error) console.error(r.error.message); process.exit(r.status ?? 1)" --
